channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Trump signs order renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America
item.description: President Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."
item.content:encoded: President Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."
item.dc:creator: Danielle Kurtzleben

item.title: Hundreds killed, over 1,000 missing after flash floods in Nepal and Tibet
item.description: Hundreds of people were killed by devastating flash floods that hit the Nepal-Tibet border, sweeping away roads, bridges and entire villages. More than 1,000 people are still missing.
item.content:encoded: Hundreds of people were killed by devastating flash floods that hit the Nepal-Tibet border, sweeping away roads, bridges and entire villages. More than 1,000 people are still missing.
item.dc:creator: Diaa Hadid

item.title: Woman talks about the search for her parents who are among the missing in Nepal
item.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep talks to Shreya Ahuja about her parents, who are missing in the floods in Nepal.
item.content:encoded: NPR's Steve Inskeep talks to Shreya Ahuja about her parents, who are missing in the floods in Nepal.
item.dc:creator: Steve Inskeep

item.title: The Beastie Boys' Mike D talks about his solo album, 'Thank You'
item.description: A conversation with Mike D of The Beastie Boys, whose new release "Thank You" is the first solo album from a member of the hip-hop trio.

item.title: Six months after war's start, feelings of abandonment set in for Iranians
item.description: A war that was supposed to last weeks and end Iran's Islamic regime has now been underway for six months. People inside Iran who were initially hopeful have grown increasingly disillusioned.

item.title: Palestinians ban kites after Israel says wayward kites will be treated as act of war
item.description: Palestinians have started burning and banning kids kites after Israel says they'll treat them as hostile acts if they blow across the border.
